# NeuromorphicLocomotionPrimitive

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A reusable spiking neural circuit that encodes a basic movement pattern (e.g., step cycle) and can be modulated by sensory feedback. Offers modular building blocks for scalable, adaptive locomotion control in iNEST, reducing design complexity for complex gaits.
